About the researcher

João Feres Júnior

Full Professor of Political Science at IESP–UERJ, where he has taught since 2010. He holds a PhD from the City University of New York and degrees in Social Sciences and Philosophy from the University of Campinas. He coordinates INCT ID-ICED, GEMAA, OLB and LEMEP.
